Effortless Lead Generation with PropertyList.es!

We go the extra mile to ensure your properties reach the right audience, maximising your chances of securing qualified leads. See how below!

Upload your properties to our MLS portal and instantly tap into a vast network of agencies and agents across Andalucía and much more coming soon. This broadens your reach significantly, attracting a larger pool of qualified clients for your listings.

  • Click “MLS LEADS” => Here you can manage all your MLS Leads and assign staff to specific enquiries.

DIRECT PORTAL LEADS – COMING SOON

By listing your properties for free on PropertyList.es they will be advertised globally and gain major exposure to find direct buyers or tenants for your listings. Secure qualified leads with credits – a cost-effective way to maximise your chances of a successful sale.

WINDOW CARD URL LEADS

Share your properties with unique, personalised URLs. Each listing features a convenient contact form at the bottom, making it simple for potential buyers or tenants to reach out.

Every new lead automatically populates into your contacts with a notification or will update history for existing contacts, PropertyList smartly updates their information and notifies you of their message. This streamlined process saves you time and ensures you never miss a potential sale.

  • Click “DIRECT LEADS” => Here you can manage all your Landing Page URL Leads and assign staff to specific enquiries.
